title: Floral Cherry Blossom Stir Fry
description: A delicate and tasty stir fry dish inspired by the beauty of cherry blossoms. This dish is light, refreshing and perfect for spring.

ingredients.name: stir-fry sauce
ingredients.notes: you can use store-bought or homemade

instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the halved cherry tomatoes and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until they start to release their juices.
Add the cooked noodles and stir-fry sauce to the skillet. Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, stirring constantly.
Stir in the floral honey and cook for 1 minute, until the sauce is bubbly and slightly thickened.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Transfer the stir-fry to a serving platter and garnish with dried cherry blossoms or edible flowers, if using.
